_doc: Every job the worker runs. cron is UTC. tier: code (no model), subscription (Codex CLI), api (metered, model pool), browser (needs the signed-in browser host). guarded: refuses while STOP is set. orderable: the bot may POST /v1/orders for it. Switch each one in context/worker-jobs-on.md (on, test, off); everything starts off.

watchdog.why: Alarms Slack on any silent role or job, so the bot runs no watchdog of its own

digest.why: Folds every job's items into digest/latest.json, the one thing the bot reads

replies-sort.why: Sorts every reply; opt-outs to suppression at once; only hot ones reach the bot (and its Reply webhook)

inbox-health.why: Warmup and inbox state, no model

campaign-stats.why: Each campaign against 5% replies, for the copy read

blocklist.why: Pushes the suppression list's emails and domains to PlusVibe every night

list-build.why: Pull, dedupe, suppress, verify a campaign's list to target (Consulti credits: only on an order whose spend the bot cleared)

list-load.why: Loads a verified list into its campaign; only when cold_email is auto in standing-approvals

radar-poll.why: New Lead Radar leads, judged by the cheap brain; 4s and 5s to the digest

show-research.why: SpeakerAgent research cycles all day, no model; stops when today's shows are found

show-score.why: Scores new shows 1 to 5 with an episode angle; 4s and 5s to the digest for the bot's pitch drafts

skool-read.why: Reads Skool groups through the signed-in browser host only; refuses without skool/ON

skool-score.why: Judges Skool posts for AI and VA need; 4s and 5s to the digest

scraper-run.why: Runs a saved scraper in tools/scrapers/ (paid rungs only through the scrape pool)

scraper-write.why: Codex writes or repairs a scraper from the bot's spec, tests it on its fixture, pilots 20 rows

scraper-retest.why: Re-tests every ok scraper on its fixture; broken ones to the digest
